comparison: Same frozen optimized host; separate fresh caches. Class headers are enabled throughout. Control uses full callees and complete array-class reads; shared uses shared filtered callee views; array narrows LLVM element-layout reads; combined enables both. Policies vary only these controls. The rejected class-predicate prototype is absent from this frozen host. Other controls identical, including four Clang workers, LLD, indexed variance, compact/block readers and delta retention. Partitioning disabled. Limits stop severe regressions; they are not the user latency targets. All recorded outputs validate.
